---
name: Uploaded post images
description: How to interpret supplied article imagery when filenames differ from a pasted content brief.
---

When a user supplies recognizable images for a new post, do not omit them solely because their upload-generated filenames differ from a filename mentioned in the brief. Treat the user's explicit request to include the attachments as the governing direction.

**Why:** A pasted brand-guide brief called for a particular hero filename, while the user attached the intended product imagery under automatically generated names. Omitting both images caused a user correction.

**How to apply:** For article builds with attached images, match the actual visual content to the requested placement; use a clearly suitable lead image as the hero/social image and other relevant supplied images in the article. Ask for clarification only when the intended placement or imagery is genuinely ambiguous.
